scope: 18 story scenes versus six approved 3D baseline families

latest_evidence.capture_rule: same native entry, 1440x900, seed 1842, approach phase, 60 frames, current source

rule: Do not raise density or call a scene aligned until the same-camera composition is reviewed against its assigned baseline.

issues.title: No approved same-camera visual acceptance set for the 18 scenes
issues.impact: Runtime captures prove construction and provenance only; they do not define the target crop, depth bands, density or top treatment for each story scene.
issues.needed_decision: For each physical family, approve one baseline camera, visible-height band, side-occupancy band and focal-depth rule before scene tuning.

issues.title: Scene assets are present but their role, depth and intended scale are not annotated
issues.impact: The layout cannot distinguish structural silhouettes, foreground cover, midground props, focal set pieces and safe travel clearance without guessing.
issues.needed_decision: Annotate AssetSpec role, depth band, measured foot and overlap policy per scene; unknown values must remain pending.

issues.title: Closed and local roof scenes lack an approved top treatment
issues.impact: Interior and clock scenes cannot be accepted from a dark screenshot while ceiling continuity and occlusion are unresolved.
issues.needed_decision: Choose authored roof/arch assets, or approve the closed-low-ceiling mesh plus its material/UV treatment.

issues.title: Current scatter algorithm is family-generic and does not encode signature composition
issues.impact: Increasing cluster counts produces a fuller frame but cannot reproduce market stalls, tea courts, caves, sewers, whale interiors or palace halls as distinct compositions.
issues.needed_decision: Define per-family and per-scene placement phases: shell rhythm, focal set-piece cadence, edge dressing, floor litter and branch/junction exclusions.

issues.title: Official fog/light pass hides layout defects during visual review
issues.impact: Dark production presentation makes missing roof layers, floating roots, intersections and empty midground difficult to judge.
issues.needed_decision: Review every scene in a neutral diagnostic pass first, then a production-light pass; acceptance requires both.

issues.title: Alice Tea and Piper Market density experiment was not a valid alignment result
issues.impact: The experiment only increased sprite counts and added fallback furniture; it did not establish target parity and has been reverted from runtime.
issues.needed_decision: Treat these captures as rejected experiments, not as progress toward scene acceptance.

next_action: Await explicit visual direction for VIS-001 through VIS-005; after decisions, implement one scene per family with before/after neutral and production captures.
